notes: One logical two-leg monthly gold/silver Brown-Forsythe scale-expansion reversion package. Q02 evaluates combined package PnL, paired costs, and activity; neither component leg is a standalone strategy.

The EA selects thirteen synchronized completed month-end gold-minus-silver log ratios, forms twelve adjacent changes in fixed old/recent blocks of six, centers each block on its even median, and trades only when the recent mean absolute deviation expands and the block medians differ. Brown-Forsythe W is a finite arithmetic diagnostic only; no critical value or p-value gate is used.

The package targets equal absolute USD notionals, caps aggregate frozen-stop risk at one RISK_FIXED budget, and follows the validated QM5_12533 logical-basket host-symbol recipe with USD tester currency and the canonical 100000 deposit. Q09 alone owns realized portfolio correlation.
